answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 60% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the summit ordering is published with the island batch, the zephyr audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early hence gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 418 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
